title: Tax/customs multi-value reconciliation
scope: Map customs, invoice, accounting and payment values with currency/date context

acceptance.text: Map customs, invoice, accounting and payment values with currency/date context
Different legitimate bases remain distinguishable; missing source does not imply false declaration
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Different legitimate bases remain distinguishable; missing source does not imply false declaration

evidence.text: ai/tools/customs_reconciliation.py maps supplier_invoice, customs_value, accounting_value, payment and transfer_pricing_value per transaction with original/transaction/reporting (LSL) Money, value dates, valuation basis and cited exchange-rate records (rate, date, source); Decimal-only half-up cent conversion, no guessed rates. 35 tests in tests/integration/test_customs_reconciliation.py pass (matching, adjustments, tolerance boundaries, FX timing, mixed-currency, validation, tenant/case-scoped TAX-022 tool, replay/order determinism).

Bases are never merged: basis_totals keep each basis separate; FOB invoice vs CIF customs bridged by cited freight/insurance adjustments (SYN-001 matched_with_adjustments); transfer-pricing and differing/unknown valuation bases are basis_difference_unreconciled gaps, not discrepancies (SYN-002). Missing customs record (SYN-004) yields only customs_value_record_missing gap with interpretation incomplete_data and zero discrepancies; missing rates give not_comparable gaps. Tests assert no fraud/misdeclaration/abuse wording in outputs.

python3 scripts/dev.py check passed (tests/integration incl. 35 TAX-073 tests); python3 scripts/quality.py passed (ruff, ruff format, mypy, npm check). Task status updated and human-review PR opened via scripts/task.py finish.

notes.text: Agent finished implementation and opened human review
